name: Blog
description: Element type that shows the elements of a category (optionally with subcategories) as a blog: newest first, with teaser, author and date, paging, search within the blog, tags and an Atom/RSS feed. The macro ::blog shows posts of several sources together. Posts are normal pages of the category.
author: Enterprise Wiki

permissions.label: Manage the blog
permissions.description: Change the settings, sections and permissions of the blog; includes editing all its posts.

permissions.label: Edit all posts
permissions.description: Write, change, move within the blog and delete all posts of the blog.

permissions.label: Contribute posts
permissions.description: Write new posts and change or delete the own ones.
